summary.text: Andrew Monarch is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 58 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Jennifer Decker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a 34-year-old working father and eighth-generation Kentuckian running on affordability, public schools, and a stronger voice for working families.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Monarch earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisville in 2013, and his career experience includes working as a director.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Monarch said he favors requiring real-time disclosure of lobbying, a searchable public database of political advertising payers, and disclosure by companies seeking state money.
He also said he would defend Medicaid, regulate data centers and remove their tax incentives, and restore Kentucky clean water legislation.
He listed public education, healthcare, affordability, housing, regulating AI and data centers, and anti-corruption as his policy interests.

sources.title: Andrew Monarch, Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
